:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-oinf-at-mle .solution}

The [observed information](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-oinf) from @sol-prac-exp-mle-oinf, evaluated at $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \bar{x}$ from @sol-prac-exp-mle-mle is

$$
I(\hat\pmean_{ML}; \vx) = \frac{2n\bar{x}}{\bar{x}^3} - \frac{n}{\bar{x}^2}
= \frac{2n}{\bar{x}^2} - \frac{n}{\bar{x}^2}
= \frac{n}{\bar{x}^2}
$$

:::
